rationale_summary: The document primarily frames AI governance as enabling responsible AI adoption within the Commission, emphasizing building AI-skilled workforces, deploying internal tools, and leading by example in trustworthy AI use. Safety and compliance measures are framed as enablers of uptake rather than restrictions on risk.

evidence_spans.quote: The European Commission is striving to become a modern, responsible and adaptive institution by implementing robust AI initiatives
ensure that AI development and use within the Commission are lawful, safe, and trustworthy
